versions.subject: Update win_renamed_meg.yml
versions.detection:
selection_sysmon:
    EventID: 
        - '1'
    OriginalFileName:
        - 'meg.exe'
filter:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\meg.exe'
condition: selection_sysmon and not filter
selection_proc:
    ParentImage|endswith:
        - '\explorer.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'C:\Windows\Temp\meg.exe'
condition: selection_proc
